{{Quote|&thinsp;'Use the comlink'? Oh, my! I forgot. I turned it off.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''C1 personal comlink''' was a portable communications device produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] were standard-issue for the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:C1_personal_comlink.png|thumb|left|180px|Comlink used by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]]]
The C1 personal [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] was manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was a small, cylindrical device with a mic grill on the top, an on/off switch fixed to the side. A [[Comm unit scrambler|scrambler]], transmitter and [[Frequency Code Sequencer]] were mounted on the device's interior. A [[Variable Frequency Programming Chip]] was located on the bottom of the comlink.<ref name="EGWT" />

It was a basic model,<ref name="AE" /> but was military-grade that featured a limited encryption module that was intended to stop eavesdroppers from listening in on messages.<ref name="EGWT" /> The C1 featured sophisticated encryption algorithms, allowing the comlink to transmit and receive secure transmissions. Within close range of an Imperial base, comlink signals were automatically boosted for optimum performance.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

An audio-only system, it could also be mounted in a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="AE" /> It supplemented a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] helmet communications system with improved range and security.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The comlink had a range of fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] which could reach low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="AE" />

==History==
The C1 was used extensively by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], being issued to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Soldier/Legends|troops]].<ref name="EGWT" />
